title: Supplied-chain recovery · exact success bounds
description: All 72 registered h=1 supplied-chain realizations succeed. This validates reconstruction of locality already present in the Hamiltonian; it does not show that locality emerged.
uncertainty: Exact one-sided Clopper–Pearson lower bounds, alpha=.05/3 per size. These separately validated binomial bounds are distinct from the undercovered bootstrap intervals. No upper bound was archived or invented.
sampleUnit: 24 independent supplied-chain realizations per size, three sizes; each realization passes the joint archived chain-recovery criterion or fails as one unit.
assumptions: Known one-dimensional nearest-neighbor interactions with hidden labels. This is a positive control with supplied locality, not a background-free model.
selection: All three chain_success objects from summary.json, retaining every field and the copied cell labels. success_fraction is the displayed successes/attempted ratio; no uncertainty is recomputed.
